newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage fell 2.08 million barrels in the week ended Sept 13 to 307.74 million barrels from 309.82 million in the prior week, the American Petroleum Institute (API) said Tuesday.
API said gasoline stocks rose 434,000 barrels in the week to 191.80 million barrels from 191.36 million barrels. Distillate stocks rose 235,000 barrels to 112.06 million from 111.82 million.
It said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) fell 592,000 barrels to 37.30 million barrels from 37.892 million barrels in the previous week.
API said crude runs to processing units rose to 14.49 million barrels from 14.42 million barrels. Percent of capacity rose to 95.0 percent in the week from 94.7 percent.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week rose to 34.78 million barrels from 34.77 million in the previous week, and crude oil imports rose to 7.57 million barrels per day from 7.37 million, API said.
